  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A no-tip destination-only target for an origin deletion or tag-only push is skipped before effective destination resolution.
  WHY: `if not target.tip: continue` runs before the destination check, so a target with `tip=""` would not have its destination validated.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1800-1813 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: The evaluator only runs the security check when `target.reaches_remote` is true, allowing a rewritten non-GitHub destination to avoid the guard for those targets.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1135, 1157 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Multiple `git remote get-url` subprocesses per push evaluation can cause latency to scale with the number of configured remotes.
  WHY: In environments with many remotes, the extra subprocesses can create a Git hook latency bottleneck, potentially triggering timeouts and affecting reliability.

No test covers `--tags` or `:feature/x` with an inline non-GitHub rewrite for origin.
